## What I changed
Three constants in `src/point_add/kaliski_state.rs` (all env-overridable):
`R_SMALL_THRESHOLD` 326->325, `kal_wtrunc_k0()` 26->24, `kal_wtrunc_margin()` 3->0.

This keeps the accepted trailmix-ludicrous point-add family and caps the positive low-fold schedule at 52 clean carries. The change trims the baked fold schedule without changing the peak-qubit operating point.

The trailmix-specific GPU scanner was first calibrated against the accepted route's positive-control nonce 6147, then used for a 100k sibling nonce window on the fold52 op stream. Candidate nonce 62632 was rechecked with the trusted CPU evaluator.
